hypotheses: The main topic is world models or environment representations used by artificial agents or robots.
This paper studies how a robot or artificial agent represents or predicts its environment.

INTRINSIC: This research uses a learned predictive internal world model for an artificial agent or robot.
The agent learns a model from data to predict future states, environment dynamics, or consequences of actions.
EXTRINSIC: This research uses an explicit map, geometric scene, spatial database, knowledge base, or symbolic representation of the environment.
The world representation is an explicit external model of the environment used by an artificial agent or robot.
COMBINED: This research combines a learned predictive model with an explicit map or environment representation.
The artificial agent uses both learned environment dynamics and an explicit spatial, geometric, or symbolic representation.
